notes.title: Developer Stream #3 - Happy New Year from Trip West Games!
notes.content:
[h3]Happy New Year Commanders![/h3] We hope you had a happy and healthy holiday season and are ready to welcome 2021 with us. This year will see the Early Access release of Ars Victor Digital! Improvements to basic gameplay, bug fixes, and minor design updates are being rolled out to alpha testers each week. Right now the big focus of the development team is on the new single-player campaign mode. Look for more screenshots and updates on that project over the next few weeks.

To kick the new year off we’re bringing you the third installment of the Developer Stream Series. This weekend will feature Lead Audio Engineer Jonathan DeBaun vs Producer Alyson Lowe. Tune into the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1380860/Ars_Victor_Digital/]Steam Store Page[/url] this [b][b]Saturday, January 2nd at 11AM PST[/b][/b] to watch the game, ask questions, and chat with the developers!


If you missed our previous developer stream with Lead Developer Zack Kirsch and Producer Alyson Lowe, you can watch it here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Om6p9Q40x6w


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38749086/66ed0b8664b1ee66182903bde9e7789b059ac585.png[/img]

Do you think you have what it takes to be a successful commander? We’re looking for fresh recruits right now to take the battlefield! The game is in the early alpha stages and we need you to help us playtest the latest builds emerging from our developers cave. Play the most up-to-date versions of the game with the hottest features while also helping us stay on track for a spring Early Access release! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/waUpeE9]Discord server[/url] or [url=https://arsvictor.com/alpha]follow the directions here[/url] to get started. See you on the battlefield, Commander!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38749086/943fbd1c166924cc0d141ebfa85423ae96438e20.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38749086/8509bdb1960d39f9e5b73578e71b3a2b457f578e.gif[/img]

Check us out on social media for more info.
